{{Nav Games Header}}

Objects collected throughout <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i> that have varying properties. They can be viewed by pressing the [[Controls (Silksong)|INVENTORY]] key.

Items that increase the capacity of Hornet's HUD meters.

{| class="article-table" width="100%"

|-
! [[File:Icon SS Silk Heart.png|link=Silk Heart|72x72px]]
[[Silk Heart]]
| <i>Silk Hearts will automatically regenerate some Silk.
|}

{| class="article-table" width="100%"
|-

== Trivia ==
[[File:Deep Memory Prompt.png|right|150x150px]]
* All consumable items, such as Shard Bundles or Rosary Strings, cannot be used in [[Elegy of the Deep|memories]]. This includes [[the Old Hearts]] memories, [[First Sinner]]'s battle, and in the [[Red Memory]] where the Inventory menu is inaccessible.
** When attempting to do so, the game displays a unique splash screen with the message: <i>"Cannot use items while in a memory."</i>
